Anas GaraDevOps Engineer · Tunisia

I like knowing what happens after
the code leaves your laptop.

My background is in software engineering. Over five years — including three in a work-study programme — I’ve moved from building applications to building the infrastructure and delivery systems around them.

Today, I work across AWS, Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes. I connect builds, deployments, monitoring, and the less glamorous details that keep a service running: DNS, TLS, backups, and clear documentation.

I work comfortably with international teams in English and French, and care about making technical decisions understandable to the people who depend on them.
